system.description:
Named Unique (heavy crossbow +1). You reload it as part of the attack. Once per encounter, when you hit with it, make one more attack with it.

Quirk (Demanding): it fires only after a whispered word, found by research or Identify. Gnome work from Tenor, off the same benches that built the first guns; its maker called it a failed experiment.

Monsters & Treasure, Named Uniques. Saves use DC 10 + half your level + the attribute named.
